title: PnCounterDelta with deliberately ordered increment and decrement maps
notes: Generated, not transcribed, by ./gradlew :wire:wireVectors -Pwire.vectors.write=true from `decoded`, then read back and pinned here. OBSERVED: UUID map keys are primitive JSON object keys and the encoder preserved `incs` document order b2 then b1; `decs` contains b1. No empty default map is emitted because both maps carry values. The order is pinned, not normalised: swapping b2 and b1 changes the generated bytes. covers [WIR1-C05], [WIR1-C09] for the UUID keys, [WIR1-C11] for the map order, and [WIR1-I01]-[WIR1-I03].
